name: wow050-mixed-ui
findings: 源有五条音频主张和独立商店画面文字，按混合载体分别清点；不能只翻译字幕。
平滑商店界面可用自然重建；移动游戏微字、闪电形擦入、禁止标志及CTA分别判断。局部通知修复形成暗块曾被拒绝。
保留未译微字、CTA纹理变化和部分音频服务失败；七语共享历史账本，不按新语言预算重置。

scoped_use_observations.observation: Used to choose source-bound local UI/CTA reconstruction and separate specialist narration; preserved unresolved moving UI rather than misreport success.
Source audio contains five claims and visual store text carries independent content; classified mixed and inventoried both.
Narration captions absent in source; scene UI/CTA classified separately. Speech phrases aligned from actual generated audio; did not invent subtitle alignment.
Codex read actual frames; Whisper/UVR/Gemini generated real audio evidence. No prohibited OCR or picture model was used.
Smooth app-store surfaces supported local reconstruction; moving gameplay labels did not. Candidate retained explicit residual defects.
Applied fast-mode actual encoded per-locale frame checks; incomplete playback and untranslated small UI retained as unapproved, not passed.
One 40.263-credit request ledger shared by all seven locales and all retries; zero-fee terminal timeouts distinguished from ambiguous audio-review charges.
No added opaque backing used. A game-notification trial produced a dark patch and was rejected rather than adopted.
Red prohibition sign retained as foreground; native CTA icon/arrows protected. Irregular lightning wipe and moving microtext remain counterexamples to complete local mask coverage.
Final TTS transcription and real mixed WAV used. Successful Gemini final comparisons distinguished from German/Thai provider failures and unreviewed phonetics.
Deterministic per-frame composition retained source native motion; smooth UI replacements useful, but CTA repair visibly changed texture/style and is not approved.
Selected local smooth-surface reconstruction plus transparent type, separately aligned TTS and original source-timing accompaniment; stopped unsafe small-label trials.
Recorded repeated app-brand/platform instances in separate source time ranges; main UI and CTA typed on native 30fps mapping.

boundary: Sanitized source-level visual/review facts. Locale audio/translation observations remain limited to original scope and video hashes. Historical reports were inspected, not a new independent or full-video acceptance. No actual artwork, paid authority or quality-approved reusable asset is provided.
